response.original_title: The Cumbres & Toltec Scenic Railroad From Trackside
response.overview: Here are video clips that show C&TS passenger trains from multiple viewpoints along the track.  If you've been aboard the trains for trips along the line, this is how your experience looked to those watching your train pass by.  Included are regular C&TS passenger trains, special charter runs, and several freight specials that simulate Denver & Rio Grande Western operations of decades ago.  Double and triple-headed locomotives are featured, as is an appearance in 2009 by the Durango Railroad Historical Society's immaculately restored 2-8-0 No. 315.
